title: Add tenant assertion profiles and audit scrub pipeline to enforce region-bound authorizations
author: Maya Patel
description: Context: Customers have requested stronger guarantees that KMS usage and service operations are region-bound and that audit logs do not leak tenant PII. This change introduces (1) tenant assertion profiles — a compact, verifiable set of attribute constraints emitted by the auth layer and consumed by the policy compiler to enforce region affinity and service-role bindings, and (2) an audit-scrub pipeline that applies deterministic redaction and sampling before logs leave the control plane. Motivation: reduce manual policy errors, provide a single source of truth for tenant-bound authorization constraints, and meet compliance needs for data residency and PII protection. Changes: - policy compiler now accepts tenant assertion profiles (YAML) that include allowed kms_regions, allowed_service_roles, and temporal constraints; compile-time validation fails closed for private deployments - auth layer (token-issuer) adds an assertion claim header (X-Redwood-Assertion-Profile) and a kms_region_affinity tag to KMS usage headers - audit-scrub pipeline stage performs deterministic masking for known PII keys (email, ssn-like tokens), configurable sampling per tenant, and retention tagging for downstream processors - redwoodctl validate-assertion CLI command for operators to lint tenant profiles and run dry-run simulations against the policy compiler - integration tests exercising cross-region RPCs, KMS call tagging, and end-to-end audit sampling - observability: added metrics for scrubbed_fields_count, scrub_latency_ms, and audit_sample_rate_by_tenant Rollout plan: feature gated behind "assertion_profiles" and "audit_scrub_pipeline" flags; enabled in staging for two tenants for 2 weeks, then gradual rollout to enterprise accounts. Checklist: - [x] Implement assertion profile schema and compiler checks - [x] Add auth-layer header emission and KMS affinity tagging - [x] Implement streaming scrub pipeline with deterministic masking and sampling - [x] Add integration and unit tests - [x] Update docs and operator CLI - [x] Add SLOs and dashboards for scrub latency and sampling correctness Related work: builds on ENG-6157 (policy compiler rework) and ENG-7042 (audit exporter refactor). Linear: ENG-9421 (assertion profiles), ENG-9503 (audit scrub pipeline).

release_notes: Introduce tenant assertion profiles to enforce region-bound authorizations and a streaming audit-scrub pipeline that performs deterministic PII masking and tenant-level sampling. Adds operator tooling (redwoodctl validate-assertion) and observability for scrub metrics.
